title: A new sign-up button at scale
intro:
Illustrative data, made up for this book. A website randomly showed its old sign-up button (A) to 150,000 visitors and a new one (B) to 150,000. Sign-ups: 6,000 on A and 6,330 on B.

Test H₀: p_A = p_B (two-sided, α = 0.05). Give z (three decimals), the p-value (four decimals) and the 95 % interval for p_A − p_B (four decimals). Is the lift worth having?

In the Workbench: **Two-sample test**, **Two proportions**, group 1 = A.
